item.title: A return to familiar formation required
item.description: When Kelechi Iheanacho limped off on Sunday, Wilfried Nancy had a choice: put Daizen Maeda through the middle and bring on a winger, or do a like-for-like swap with Johnny Kenny. item.title: ‘SADNESS’ AS LAWWELL STEPS DOWN
item.description: PETER LAWWELL is stepping down as chairman of Celtic with effect from December 31. Current non-executive director Brian Wilson will take up the role of interim chairman, until a permanent appointment is made. The announcement was made the club as the champions prepared for a crucial Premiership game against Dundee United at Tannadice this evening. [...]

item.title: CONFIRMED: SCALES, ENGELS OUT IN SHAKE-UP
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY has dropped Liam Scales and Arne Engels from his starting line-up to face Dundee United at Tannadice tonight. Johnny Kenny and Luke McCowan also get the nod to be in at the kick-off while Benjamin Nygren, an unused substitute in the 3-1 loss to St Mirren, is again among the stand-by squad. TEAM: [...]
